records.text: Explain why database indexes make searching records faster.
records.answer: An index provides a lookup structure so a query can avoid scanning every row.

records.text: Describe how a database index speeds up finding rows.
records.answer: The lookup structure narrows the set of rows read for a query.

records.text: Explain how encryption keeps a private message unreadable without a key.
records.answer: Encryption transforms plaintext into ciphertext that requires a suitable key to decrypt.

records.text: Describe how encrypting messages protects their contents with secret keys.
records.answer: A cipher uses a key to turn readable data into ciphertext; decryption reverses it.
